text:
eve: Heads-up: starting quiet window for py/ts SDK publish at 21:45 UTC. Final checks: signatures, dist-tags, release notes. Please ack.

mike: ack. running GPG verify on artifacts now.

release-bot: [job] queued: py-sdk v1.15.0, ts-sdk v2.5.0. CI green.

mike: py wheel sig OK. npm package shows mixed verification on mirrors (some return "key not found").

infra: if mirror propagation lags, recommendation: tag canary only, extend canary window 30m, do not flip 'latest' until green across mirrors. If failures persist past window, pin back to previous and deprecate release.

katie: release notes updated with deprecation/migration text. adding FAQ on signature checks.

eve: agree we delay promotion. release-bot, set canary tag and extend window.

release-bot: canary tags applied. window extended to 22:15 UTC.

mike: mirrors catching up now, verify showing good keys on 80% of nodes. proceeding with smoke.

release-bot: smoke ok for both SDKs. Canary metrics: error rate steady. Proceed to promote at 22:10 unless objections.

eve: promote but flip TS first, wait 45s, then Py. If any mirror shows signature error post-promo, revert by pinning and deprecating.

release-bot: promoted ts-sdk@2.5.0 -> latest. promoted py-sdk@1.15.0 -> latest.

infra: monitoring installs and error spikes. keeping rollback commands ready.

katie: sending status update and posting release notes.

release-bot: [announce] Release complete. Thread closed. :rocket:
